name: Distract
body:
Discipline telepathy [mind-affecting]
Level cryptic 0 (see note), dread 0/1, gifted blade 1, marksman 0, psion/wilder 0, psychic warrior 0, tactician 1

MANIFESTING

Display M
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration concentration, up to 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Power Resistance Yes
Power Points psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

You cause your subject’s mind to wander, distracting her. Subjects under the effect of distract make all Perception and Sense Motive checks at a –4 penalty.

Augment If you expend your psionic focus when manifesting this power, the cost of the power is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
